reuse.why: Follows the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked guard pattern with a sibling helper. Each link function calls the new helper separately, though, rather than through the existing single pre-link entry point.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once. The only repetition is one added call line in each of the six provider link functions, alongside the existing guard call.

placement.why: A well-named precondition helper next to the existing link guard in accounts/app.ts.

scope.why: Only the new guard, its six call sites and focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: Clear and single-sourced. A future seventh provider must remember two guard calls instead of one combined precondition.

one_place.where: ensureAccountIsOpenForLinking in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six link*Account functions.
